events.title: Ai2 opens AstaBrief-8B for fast cited research reports
events.title_zh: Ai2 开源快速生成引文报告的 AstaBrief-8B
events.summary: Ai2 released AstaBrief-8B, an Apache-2.0 model that turns a research question plus retrieved scientific excerpts into a cited report in one pass. It starts from Qwen3-8B, uses supervised fine-tuning and offline DPO, and ships with weights, training datasets and a local PDF example. On the 100-question ScholarQA-CS2 test set, Ai2 reports stronger answer-and-citation scores than its SFT checkpoint and similar aggregate quality to slower multi-step systems.
events.why_it_matters: For teams building literature assistants, AstaBrief offers a small, inspectable alternative to multi-step proprietary report pipelines. The reported gains come from Ai2's own retrieval and evaluation setup, so test citation entailment and omitted evidence on your corpus before adoption.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 AstaBrief-8B。这个 Apache-2.0 模型一次生成带引文的研究报告，输入是研究问题和已检索的论文片段。模型基于 Qwen3-8B，经监督微调和离线 DPO 训练；权重、训练数据与本地 PDF 示例均已公开。Ai2 在 100 题 ScholarQA-CS2 测试集上报告，它的答案与引文综合分高于 SFT checkpoint，并接近更慢的多步系统。
events.summary_en: Ai2 released AstaBrief-8B, an Apache-2.0 model that turns a research question plus retrieved scientific excerpts into a cited report in one pass. It starts from Qwen3-8B, uses supervised fine-tuning and offline DPO, and ships with weights, training datasets and a local PDF example. On the 100-question ScholarQA-CS2 test set, Ai2 reports stronger answer-and-citation scores than its SFT checkpoint and similar aggregate quality to slower multi-step systems.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做文献助手的团队来说，AstaBrief 提供了一个小型、可检查的替代方案，不必完全依赖多步闭源报告流水线。现有结果来自 Ai2 自己的检索与评测环境，上线前要用自有语料检查引文是否真的支持结论，以及关键证据是否被漏掉。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building literature assistants, AstaBrief offers a small, inspectable alternative to multi-step proprietary report pipelines. The reported gains come from Ai2's own retrieval and evaluation setup, so test citation entailment and omitted evidence on your corpus before adoption.

technical_details.training: SFT followed by offline DPO; DPO trained on 8 H100 GPUs
technical_details.data: 39.5K filtered SFT examples and about 6K preference pairs reported by Ai2
technical_details.evaluation: ScholarQA-CS2 test average 87.0; citation precision 90.5 and citation recall 78.2, author-reported
technical_details.availability: Ungated weights, training datasets and local report-generation example

technical_details_zh.训练: 先 SFT，再做离线 DPO；DPO 使用 8 张 H100
technical_details_zh.数据: Ai2 报告 3.95 万条筛选后的 SFT 样本与约 6000 对偏好数据
technical_details_zh.评测: ScholarQA-CS2 测试集综合分 87.0；引文精确率 90.5、召回率 78.2，均为作者报告
technical_details_zh.可用性: 无门禁权重、训练数据集与本地报告生成示例

events.next_action_zh: 用 20 个自有研究问题比较引文支持率、关键证据遗漏和单份报告延迟。
events.next_action_en: Compare citation support, missed key evidence and report latency on 20 internal research questions.

evidence.claim_zh: AstaBrief-8B 的权重、训练数据与本地示例已公开；Ai2 报告它在 ScholarQA-CS2 上改善引文质量。
evidence.claim_en: AstaBrief-8B ships open weights, training data and a local example; Ai2 reports improved citation quality on ScholarQA-CS2.

changes.summary_zh: Ai2 开源快速生成引文报告的 AstaBrief-8B
changes.summary_en: Ai2 opens AstaBrief-8B for fast cited research reports

events.title: DeepSeek opens a plugin-first desktop agent harness
events.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源插件优先的桌面 agent harness
events.summary: DeepSeek released DeepSeek Harness in worldwide public preview for macOS, Windows and a local web UI. The MIT-licensed project uses an everything-is-a-plugin architecture for everyday work, coding, research and background tasks. Agent teams, auto-approval review, scheduled tasks and voice input are still marked experimental, and the repository warns of compatibility-breaking changes.
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating local agent runtimes, DeepSeek Harness is a fully inspectable desktop and web option with a public plugin architecture. Its developer-preview stability and experimental approval features require isolation before serious work.
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 进入全球公开预览，提供 macOS、Windows 与本地 Web UI。这个 MIT 开源项目采用“一切皆插件”架构，可处理日常办公、编码、研究和后台任务。Agent teams、自动审批复核、定时任务与语音输入仍标为实验性，仓库也明确警告会有破坏性兼容变化。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek released DeepSeek Harness in worldwide public preview for macOS, Windows and a local web UI. The MIT-licensed project uses an everything-is-a-plugin architecture for everyday work, coding, research and background tasks. Agent teams, auto-approval review, scheduled tasks and voice input are still marked experimental, and the repository warns of compatibility-breaking changes.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估本地 agent 运行时的团队来说，DeepSeek Harness 提供了可检查的桌面与 Web 方案，还有公开插件架构。开发者预览的稳定性和实验性审批能力意味着只能先在隔离环境试用。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams evaluating local agent runtimes, DeepSeek Harness is a fully inspectable desktop and web option with a public plugin architecture. Its developer-preview stability and experimental approval features require isolation before serious work.

technical_details.availability: worldwide public preview; macOS, Windows and local web UI
technical_details.experimental: agent teams, auto-approval review, scheduled tasks and voice input
technical_details.stability: developer preview with compatibility-breaking changes expected

technical_details_zh.可用性: 全球公开预览；macOS、Windows 与本地 Web UI
technical_details_zh.架构: 基于 Cordis 的一切皆插件
technical_details_zh.实验功能: agent teams、自动审批复核、定时任务与语音输入
technical_details_zh.稳定性: 开发者预览，预计会有破坏性兼容变化

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在一次性账户和隔离目录中安装，测试插件权限、自动审批、失败恢复与数据外发。
events.next_action_en: Install it with a disposable account and isolated directory for one day; test plugin permissions, auto-approval, recovery and data egress.

evidence.claim_zh: DeepSeek Harness 已全球公开预览并以 MIT 开源，桌面安装包和本地 Web UI 均可用。
evidence.claim_en: DeepSeek Harness is in worldwide public preview under MIT, with desktop downloads and a local web UI.

changes.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 进入全球公开预览并开源
changes.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness enters worldwide public preview and opens its code

events.title: IndexTeam opens a 35B MoE model for constrained translation
events.title_zh: IndexTeam 开源 35B MoE 模型处理约束翻译
events.summary: IndexTeam released preview weights for Index-Translate-35B-A3B, an Apache-2.0 multilingual translation model with 35B total and 3B active parameters. It supports 150 languages and instruction constraints such as terminology, style and JSON output. Code and an inference client are public, but the benchmarks are author-reported and no hosted inference provider is listed.
events.why_it_matters: For localization teams, instruction-following translation can keep terminology and structured output in one pass instead of adding post-processing. Public weights permit direct testing, while the preview label and vendor-only evidence argue against production adoption.
events.summary_zh: IndexTeam 发布 Index-Translate-35B-A3B 预览权重。这是一款 Apache-2.0 的多语翻译模型，总参数 35B、每次激活 3B，支持 150 种语言，以及术语、风格和 JSON 输出等指令约束。代码与推理 client 已公开，但基准仍由作者报告，也没有托管推理入口。
events.summary_en: IndexTeam released preview weights for Index-Translate-35B-A3B, an Apache-2.0 multilingual translation model with 35B total and 3B active parameters. It supports 150 languages and instruction constraints such as terminology, style and JSON output. Code and an inference client are public, but the benchmarks are author-reported and no hosted inference provider is listed.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地化团队来说，遵循指令的翻译模型能在一次推理中保留术语与结构化输出，减少后处理。公开权重允许直接验证；预览状态和仅有厂商证据则不适合直接用于生产。
events.why_it_matters_en: For localization teams, instruction-following translation can keep terminology and structured output in one pass instead of adding post-processing. Public weights permit direct testing, while the preview label and vendor-only evidence argue against production adoption.

technical_details.constraints: terminology, style, formatting and JSON output
technical_details.availability: preview weights, code and inference client; no hosted provider
technical_details.author_results: FLORES COMET22 0.8794; instTrans instruction-following 0.8336; 2.4% off-target rate on low-resource languages

technical_details_zh.架构: 基于 Qwen3.5 的 MoE；总参数 35B、激活 3B
technical_details_zh.约束: 术语、风格、格式与 JSON 输出
technical_details_zh.可用性: 预览权重、代码与推理 client；无托管入口
technical_details_zh.作者结果: FLORES COMET22 0.8794；instTrans 指令遵循 0.8336；低资源语言偏离目标率 2.4%

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开权重跑术语、JSON 与低资源语言样本，对比现有模型的质量、约束遵循、延迟和显存。
events.next_action_en: In one day, run terminology, JSON and low-resource samples with the public weights and compare quality, constraint following, latency and memory.

evidence.claim_zh: IndexTeam 已公开预览权重、代码、推理 client 与作者评测。
evidence.claim_en: IndexTeam released preview weights, code, an inference client and author evaluations.

changes.summary_zh: IndexTeam 公开约束翻译模型的预览权重
changes.summary_en: IndexTeam releases preview weights for constrained translation

events.title: DwarfStar builds a narrow local runtime for frontier open weights
events.title_zh: DwarfStar 为前沿开放权重打造专用本地运行时
events.summary: DwarfStar is an MIT-licensed C inference engine specialized for DeepSeek V4, GLM 5.x and Qwen3.8 on Metal, CUDA and ROCm. It combines project-specific GGUFs, SSD streaming, persistent KV caches, OpenAI- and Anthropic-style APIs and a native coding agent. The project has more than 23,000 GitHub stars but describes itself as fast-changing beta software.
events.why_it_matters: For teams with high-memory workstations, ds4 offers a focused path to run large routed-MoE models locally instead of a generic runtime. Its narrow model support and beta stability require hardware-specific validation before relying on it.
events.summary_zh: DwarfStar 是 MIT 开源的 C 推理引擎，专门支持 DeepSeek V4、GLM 5.x 和 Qwen3.8，覆盖 Metal、CUDA 与 ROCm。它把项目专用 GGUF、SSD 流式加载、持久化 KV cache、OpenAI/Anthropic 风格 API 和原生 coding agent 放进同一栈。项目已有 2.3 万多个 GitHub star，但官方仍称其为快速变化的 beta。
events.summary_en: DwarfStar is an MIT-licensed C inference engine specialized for DeepSeek V4, GLM 5.x and Qwen3.8 on Metal, CUDA and ROCm. It combines project-specific GGUFs, SSD streaming, persistent KV caches, OpenAI- and Anthropic-style APIs and a native coding agent. The project has more than 23,000 GitHub stars but describes itself as fast-changing beta software.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对有大内存工作站的团队来说，ds4 提供了一条专门运行大型 routed-MoE 的本地路径，而不是通用推理框架。模型支持范围窄、版本仍是 beta，必须先按实际硬件验证。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams with high-memory workstations, ds4 offers a focused path to run large routed-MoE models locally instead of a generic runtime. Its narrow model support and beta stability require hardware-specific validation before relying on it.

technical_details.models: DeepSeek V4/V4.1, GLM 5.x, Qwen3.8 Flash Next
technical_details.features: asymmetric quantization, SSD streaming, disk-persistent KV cache, tensor and pipeline parallelism
technical_details.interfaces: CLI, local APIs and native coding agent

technical_details_zh.能力: 非对称量化、SSD 流式加载、磁盘持久化 KV cache、张量与流水线并行
technical_details_zh.接口: CLI、本地 API 与原生 coding agent

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在目标工作站跑官方量化模型，测加载、首 token、长上下文吞吐、重启恢复和输出一致性。
events.next_action_en: In one day on the target workstation, test an official quant for load time, first token, long-context throughput, restart recovery and output parity.

evidence.claim_zh: ds4 以 MIT 开源，提供专用模型量化、本地 API、持久化 KV cache 与多后端支持。
evidence.claim_en: ds4 is MIT-licensed and provides model-specific quants, local APIs, persistent KV caches and multiple backends.

changes.summary_zh: DwarfStar 公开专用本地推理运行时 ds4
changes.summary_en: DwarfStar opens the specialized ds4 local inference runtime

events.title: AutoTrust decision models surge on Hugging Face without independent validation
events.title_zh: AutoTrust 决策模型在 Hugging Face 激增但缺少独立验证
events.summary: AutoTrust published two Apache-2.0 decision-oriented models: GEV-26B-Decide, based on Gemma 4, and JEV-27B-VL, based on Qwen3.8. Their Hugging Face pages showed roughly 447,000 and 1.28 million downloads during this review. The only listed evaluation is an author-run, unverified Decision Index result, and JEV lists no model-index result.
events.why_it_matters: High download velocity is useful for discovery but does not establish model quality. Teams should not spend evaluation time until AutoTrust publishes a reproducible benchmark package or independent results appear. The current signal is unusually strong attention paired with weak verification.
events.summary_zh: AutoTrust 发布两款 Apache-2.0 的决策模型：基于 Gemma 4 的 GEV-26B-Decide，以及基于 Qwen3.8 的 JEV-27B-VL。本次复核时，两者在 Hugging Face 分别约有 44.7 万和 128 万次下载。现有评测只有作者自测且未验证的 Decision Index 结果，JEV 甚至没有 model-index 成绩。
events.summary_en: AutoTrust published two Apache-2.0 decision-oriented models: GEV-26B-Decide, based on Gemma 4, and JEV-27B-VL, based on Qwen3.8. Their Hugging Face pages showed roughly 447,000 and 1.28 million downloads during this review. The only listed evaluation is an author-run, unverified Decision Index result, and JEV lists no model-index result.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 高下载增速适合发现线索，却不能证明模型质量。在 AutoTrust 公开可复现 benchmark 套件或出现独立结果前，团队不必投入验证时间。当前信号是关注度异常高，但可核查证据偏弱。
events.why_it_matters_en: High download velocity is useful for discovery but does not establish model quality. Teams should not spend evaluation time until AutoTrust publishes a reproducible benchmark package or independent results appear. The current signal is unusually strong attention paired with weak verification.

technical_details.evaluation: GEV reports 62.48 on author-run Decision Index 0.2.1; result unverified; JEV has no model-index result

technical_details_zh.评测: GEV 报告作者自测 Decision Index 0.2.1 得分 62.48，未验证；JEV 无 model-index 结果

events.next_action_zh: 暂不投入；等公开可复现 benchmark 或独立评测后再重新评估。
events.next_action_en: Do not invest yet; reassess after a reproducible benchmark package or independent evaluation appears.

evidence.claim_zh: 两款公开模型获得异常高下载量，但当前唯一结构化成绩是未验证的作者自测。
evidence.claim_en: The two public models show unusually high downloads, while the only structured score is an unverified author-run result.

changes.summary_zh: AutoTrust 决策模型以高下载量进入召回自检
changes.summary_en: AutoTrust decision models surface through unusually high download velocity
